plan.rationale: A residential and commercial plumber with a genuinely wide scope, from new site plumbing to tiling and paving. Services list carries the detail since that is where the real facts live. Pillars group the six offerings into a scannable set, process explains how a job actually runs from quote to sign off, and a notice carries the free quote line they explicitly offered. No photos on file so gallery slots are requested rather than assumed filled. Slate and technical-sans keep it straight and trustworthy without dressing up a trade business as something fancier.

sections.headline: Building. Renovating. Maintaining. Watershed Plumbing Does It All.
sections.subheadline: Residential and commercial plumbing across new construction, renovations, and everyday repairs, handled with clear communication and transparent pricing.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of you or your team on an active job site, mid task, in work clothes. Natural light, no posing.

sections.heading: A plumbing partner for the whole job, not just the leak
paragraphs: Watershed Plumbing handles residential and commercial work across Cape Town, from plumbing on brand new construction sites through to fixing a dripping tap. We believe in clear communication and transparent pricing, so you know what you are paying for before we start.

items.title: New Site Construction Plumbing
items.body: Complete plumbing installations for new construction projects, built for seamless integration and long-lasting performance.

items.title: Bathroom Renovations
items.body: From fixture installation to complete overhauls, we handle every detail of your bathroom transformation with precision.

items.title: Comprehensive Maintenance
items.body: Preventative and reactive maintenance to keep your plumbing systems running smoothly and minimise disruptions and costly repairs.

items.title: Drain Laying and Repairs
items.body: Specialised drain laying and repair work, addressing blockages and ensuring efficient wastewater management.

items.title: Geyser Installation and Repairs
items.body: Professional installation and repair of geysers, for reliable hot water in your home or business.

items.title: Tiling and Paving
items.body: Expert tiling and paving services that add both functionality and aesthetic appeal to your property.

sections.heading: From first call to finished job

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.body: Call us for a free quote or to discuss your project, whether it is a new build, a renovation, or a repair.

steps.title: We assess the work
steps.body: We look at what the job needs, residential or commercial, and talk you through it with transparent pricing.

steps.title: We carry out the work
steps.body: Our team completes the installation, repair, or renovation with attention to every detail.

steps.title: We keep the relationship going
steps.body: We aim to build long-term relationships with our clients through reliable, trustworthy service on future maintenance needs.
